description: Live cases for failures that were found in real runs (see docs/regressions.md).  Each one spans the model, so the unit test alone does not prove it.  Expected outputs were written before any run; not yet run live.

cases.label: A hyphenated time is read as minutes
cases.input: Give me a 20-minute workout with dumbbells.  Chest.

expect.notes: A plan, with no question about time.  Calculated total between 15 and 25 minutes.  A failing score is a clarifying question or an error.

cases.label: Exercise names that contain parentheses are accepted
cases.input: I have 20 minutes and a mat.  Core.

expect.notes: A plan whose names match the tool results, including any name with parentheses.  A failing score is the visible error caused by a name that the checks could not read.
